issue:
LogJobReturnCallback import path broken after refactoring

Description

LogJobReturnCallback was moved to a separate file but the import path wasn't updated in the test app.

When running an app that uses LogJobReturnCallback, it fails with a FileNotFoundError because the callback can't be found at the expected location.

Bug introduced in the refactoring that moved LogJobReturnCallback from hydra/experimental/callbacks.py to hydra/experimental/log_job_return_callback.py

To reproduce:
```python
from hydra.experimental.callbacks import LogJobReturnCallback  # This import will fail

# Should be:
# from hydra.experimental.log_job_return_callback import LogJobReturnCallback
```

The app tries to import LogJobReturnCallback from the old location but it's no longer there, causing the application to crash when it tries to use the callback.
